real-estate.outlook: Sunderland Riverside, Forth Yards Newcastle, and Gateshead Quays anchor the regeneration pipeline. IAMP advanced manufacturing park Phase 2 active. Newcastle Helix innovation district maturing with new occupiers. County Durham housing growth programme progressing. North Tyneside coastal regeneration underway.

energy.outlook: Teesworks is the UK's most significant energy transition site — SeAH Wind XXXL monopile factory operational, Net Zero Teesside CCS progressing, and AI data centre campus planned. Cambois data centre campus (£10bn, Northumberland) is the region's most significant new investment. Northern Powergrid RIIO-ED2 £1bn active. Blyth offshore wind hub expanding.

rail.outlook: Tyne & Wear Metro New Fleet (46 Stadler trains) in delivery — transformational fleet replacement. Metro extensions to Washington and Cobalt in feasibility. Northumberland Line opened December 2024 with extension to Newbiggin proposed. Leamside Line feasibility contractor appointed. Darlington Station redevelopment active.

data-centres.outlook: North East has emerged as a major UK data centre location. Cambois (Northumberland) — QTS/Blackstone 720MW campus is the UK's largest planned data centre development. Teesworks AI data centre campus under discussion. Stellium Newcastle Cobalt Park expanding. AI Growth Zone designation driving further investment.

utilities.outlook: Northumbrian Water AMP8 £4.5bn programme in full delivery. Tees Barrage flood defence programme underway. Cadent Gas NE network modernisation active under RIIO-GD2. Environment Agency coastal and flood programme active on North Sea coast.

highways.outlook: A1 Birtley to Coal House nearing completion. A19 junction upgrades under pressure from data centre traffic growth. A66 Trans-Pennine dualling — major procurement active, spanning NE/NW boundary. A1 Morpeth to Felton dualling in construction. Seaton Burn roundabout upgrade lobbying intensifying.
